body:
go.mod + main.go: parse/analyze/build/fmt/ci-status subcommands mirroring parena/src/main.c's own usage text and argument-shape validation 1:1 (founder: 'it should have the same api as parena like yarn is the same as npm'). Every subcommand validates its real argument shape and reports an honest 'not yet implemented (see NORTHSTAR.md, Phase N)' rather than silently no-op'ing. go build/go vet clean (GOWORK=off, standalone module). Verified by hand-exercising every subcommand's usage-error and not-implemented paths. Also folded in two more founder real-time corrections this session: 'dog food it...doesnt allocate on the heap' (low-allocation Go implementation discipline, documented in NORTHSTAR.md) and 'use parena primatives adding to the stdlibs when it helps' (confirms the selfhost/*.prn-leaning architecture). Commits fa0b13d/f44e108.

⚓ ☃
title: Real burrow CLI shell shipped -- API parity with parena's own command surface
